query: SELECT ?item ?label ?alt ?links WHERE { ?item (wdt:P31|wdt:P279)/wdt:P279* wd:Q7802 . ?item rdfs:label ?label . FILTER(LANG(?label) = "en") OPTIONAL { ?item skos:altLabel ?alt . FILTER(LANG(?alt) = "en") } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?links . FILTER(?links >= 2) }

items.a: Focaccia di Recco col formaggio PGI
Louis XVI, King of France and Navarre
